Wolf"..."
ｅｔｃ／Ｇ中尉"P-Professor? Gone. Both the forged thunderbolt and Silver Star."
Wolf"No."
ｅｔｃ／Ｇ中尉"Eh?"
Wolf"Not gone. Become a minute black point."
Wolf"Gravity raised beyond its limit made it collapse upon itself..."
ｅｔｃ／Ｇ中尉"..."
ｅｔｃ／Ｇ中尉"D-does that mean... failure?"
Wolf"No."
Wolf"Success."
Wolf"That black point, a vortex of gravity, falls toward the center of the earth!"

Wolf"This light... Water bearing God's life..."
Wolf"The element of tsurugi."
Wolf"...Oh... Everything like crystal..."
Wolf"...Metal crystal!"
Wolf"Without undergoing tsurugi forging... Bathed in concentrated water... Thus... purely becoming part of God."
Wolf"Agape, binding all things!"
Wolf"So it was..."
Wolf"The truth of Kristallnacht."
Wolf"Wise Adolf... You were right to see divine revelation in it."
Wolf"I was right to believe you."
Wolf"My dream... My inference of God was right."
